title: Structured Denoising Diffusion Models in Discrete State-Spaces

openAccessPdf.disclaimer: Notice: Paper or abstract available at https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.03006, which is subject to the license by the author or copyright owner provided with this content. Please go to the source to verify the license and copyright information for your use.

tldr.text: D3PMs are diffusion-like generative models for discrete data that generalize the multinomial diffusion model of Hoogeboom et al. 2021, by going beyond corruption processes with uniform transition probabilities and showing that the choice of transition matrix is an important design decision that leads to improved results in image and text domains.
